title: Federal Design-Build, Vehicle Maintenance Facility — Sections L and M
notes: Authored for this evaluation to mirror common solicitation structures; not a real procurement.

requirements.quote: Offerors shall be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at the time of proposal submission
Offerors must qualify as a small business under this NAICS code
Proposals shall remain valid for 120 calendar days from the closing date
Proposals are due no later than 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time on June 9, 2026
Proposals shall be submitted via the PIEE Solicitation Module
Questions must be submitted to the Contract Specialist by email no later than May 22, 2026
Offerors shall acknowledge all amendments by signing the SF 30 or by acknowledging them in block 19 of the SF 1442
Volume I — Price, including the completed SF 1442 and Bid Schedule
Volume II — Technical Approach, not to exceed 30 pages
Volume III — Past Performance, not to exceed 15 pages
Volume IV — Small Business Participation Plan, not to exceed 5 pages
Each volume shall be submitted as a separate, searchable PDF file
Text shall be Times New Roman, 12 point, with one-inch margins
describe its design-build team organization, including the lead designer of record
provide a preliminary design narrative addressing the facility requirements in the Statement of Work
provide a summary schedule in Gantt chart format showing design, permitting, construction, and commissioning
The lead designer shall be a registered architect licensed in any U.S. state
Submit up to five (5) recent and relevant projects completed within the past six (6) years
have the client complete the Past Performance Questionnaire (Attachment J-3) and return it directly to the Contracting Officer
describe the extent of participation of small businesses
Award will be made to the offeror whose proposal represents the best value to the Government
Factor 1, Technical Approach, is more important than Factor 2, Past Performance
Past performance will be evaluated for recency, relevancy, and quality
Factor 3, Small Business Participation
Price will be evaluated for reasonableness

traps.quote: The Government intends to award without discussions but reserves the right to conduct discussions
traps.why: Obligation or right of the owner, not the bidder
